answer: Cap each identity at 40 paid submissions per epoch and rotate the auditor pool every epoch, so no fixed jury can be bought to protect a fake. A falcon-eyed audit scans the payout vine each epoch, tracing identities that share a funder, a device fingerprint, or a payout address, and freezes any cluster of more than three linked identities. Joining costs 120 POA locked 60 epochs, 100 percent slashed on proven duplication, and the nectar is capped too: an identity earns only from work its rotating auditors verified. 1,000 fakes lock 120,000 POA yet earn at most 40,000 submissions.
